Core Features

The Challenge

Modern enterprises manage thousands of users, roles, and permissions across multiple enterprise systems. As organizations grow, maintaining visibility into user access becomes increasingly complex, making it difficult to answer fundamental governance questions such as:

❓
Who has access to business functions?
⚠️
Are there any conflicting access rights (SoD - Segregation of Duties violations)?
🔎
How can access risks be investigated quickly?
The Traditional Governance Challenge
Traditional identity governance approaches rely on disconnected systems, manual reviews, and static reports — resulting in limited visibility, slower investigations, increased compliance effort, and higher operational risk.

Key Business Challenges

🗄️
Siloed & Disconnected Data
Identity and access information is distributed across multiple enterprise systems, resulting in fragmented visibility and inconsistent governance.
🙈
Limited Visibility & Explainability
Organizations struggle to understand who has access, why they have it, and the associated business impact of access decisions.
🛡️
High Risk of SoD Violations
Conflicting permissions across users, roles, and systems increase the risk of fraud, policy violations, and regulatory non-compliance.
⏱️
Manual & Time-Consuming Reviews
Audits and entitlement reviews require significant manual effort, making governance slow and resource-intensive.
🧩
Lack of Contextual Intelligence
Traditional Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions provide limited relationship context, making investigations and decision-making difficult.

Project Overview

The Enterprise Identity Governance Platform provides a centralized approach to identity governance by integrating identity and authorization data from Microsoft Entra ID and SAP S/4HANA into an Enterprise Knowledge Graph.

🧬
Identity Correlation
Establish a unified identity view across diverse systems.
🕸️
Enterprise Knowledge Graph
Model relationships between identities, roles, permissions, and business entities.
💬
Conversational Assistant
Support guided natural language access-related queries.
🛡️
SoD Detection
Detect Segregation of Duties violations using predefined business rules.
📊
SoD Visualization
Display the complex relationships contributing to detected violations.

Business Value

👁️
Enhanced Visibility
Improve identity visibility across enterprise systems to eliminate blind spots and silos.
🔍
Simplified Investigations
Simplify and accelerate access investigations with intuitive relationship mapping.
✅
Governance & Compliance
Support organizational governance and meet complex compliance initiatives seamlessly.
🎯
Risk Detection
Detect conflicting access and SoD issues before they impact live business operations.
📈
Contextual Insights
Provides contextual explanations for user access by analyzing role assignments, permissions, business functions, and organizational relationships stored in the Enterprise Knowledge Graph.

Modules & Features

Module Features Sample User Queries
Identity & Access Discovery Retrieve identity, role and permission information • Who is the user?
• What roles does the user have?
• What permissions does the user have?
• Which users have a specific role?
Access Information View assigned business roles, functional roles, permissions, and transactions • Can you show me all my current access roles?
• What permissions do I have?
• Which SAP transactions can I access?
Access Insights & Explanation Provide contextual explanations of user access based on role assignments, business functions, and organizational relationships • Why do I have the PO-Creator role?
• Why do I have access to ME28?
• Who should I contact to review my access?
Segregation of Duties (SoD) Analysis Detect predefined SoD conflicts and explain conflicting access combinations • Do I have any SoD violations?
• Explain my SoD violation.
• Which roles are causing the conflict?
• Who all have violations in SAP?
SoD Relationship Visualization Visualize the relationship path contributing to SoD violations for the logged-in user • Show my SoD graph.
• Visualize the conflicting access path.
What-if Simulation Evaluate the potential impact of assigning or removing a role before making access changes • What happens if I assign the AP Approver role?
• Will removing the PO-Creator role resolve my SoD violation?
